verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI supports agents running 'on a durable background queue' and durable execution that persists across restarts/failures, which enables autonomous background operation, but there's no first-party scheduler/trigger system or evidence of a hosted always-on automation service — users must wire up the queue/durable infra themselves. Community evidence also notes gaps in production wiring (reconnection, event infra) that a background automation would need. Missing for 10: a documented scheduling/trigger mechanism, a managed/hosted background execution offering, and independent hands-on confirmation of long-running unattended automations succeeding in production.
